text:
Renee: flagging a small docs inconsistency in metering.md — the wording implies billing is per-request. that's out of date: attribution is per-token and can be overridden with a header.
Omar: good catch. can you paste the line?
Renee: current: 'Requests are billed at the tier associated with the API key.' propose: 'Billing is calculated per token; tokens are attributed to a tier based on the API key or an optional override header.'
Hector: add tiny examples showing split attribution and the header name change (old X-Plan -> X-Redwood-Client-Tier).
Renee: draft curl snippet:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/complete \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Client-Tier: pro" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
Maya: also note: routing fallbacks (model variants) do NOT change attribution unless header/api-key differs. saves support churn.
LMS-testing-bot: link-check: docs/metering.md -> broken /billing/tiers, suggested /pricing/tiers.
Renee: will update copy, add node + python snippets, fix link, and add a one-line docs-test to assert /pricing/tiers. ping @Omar for review when PR is up.
Omar: will review. short and clear please.
Maya: approve on sight for analytics wording.
Renee: PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/redwood/docs/pull/1001 — includes copy + snippets + linkfix + test. merging after CI. :ship:
